title: Vigilants
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Vigilants of Stendarr: vanilla, Dawnguard, The Cause (`ccbgssse067-daedinv.esm`) and Vigil Enforcer (`ccmtysse002-ve.esl`). Vampiric Vigilants (`DLC1_WESC02_VigilantVampire`, Fenrik) stay under *Vampires*. bands-of-power.md puts the Vigilants in Experienced (V); archetype-tiers.md §3.1 pins every Vigilant list to rung 05, raised 25 → 35, which is Elite (VI), so the two disagree until the user settles it.
